itemText: Make phrase cards show an English sentence with the target phrase blanked out, a Russian translation of the whole sentence and a hint with the first letters, instead of only a Russian meaning and a synonym.
Have the generator check that the blanked sentence could not be completed by another common phrase, and drop or rewrite sentences that fail.

Generate for every phrase several front wordings, each short: the Russian translation, a different Russian wording and a plain English explanation written the way a B1 to B2 speaker would put it, none of them containing the phrase.
Show these front wordings as choices in triage on web, iPhone and Mac, reusing the existing sentence variant picker, and keep only the wordings the owner selects.
Shares the triage screens with model-fusion's fusion-triage, so build after it or merge the two pickers.

Let a phrase card front show the target sentence with only part of the phrase hidden, for example the first word kept and the rest blanked, so the owner can reach the phrase from the visible words and the Russian translation.
Make the hidden part grow as a phrase is learned, starting with most words visible and ending with the whole phrase blanked, using the card's review history to decide the step.
